summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Admin Wilayah (regional admin) feature. Created /app/backend/tests/test_admin_wilayah.py — 19/19 pytest tests pass (5.87s). Coverage: (1) Super Admin can create admin_wilayah with valid DKI region, is rejected without region or with invalid region; (2) Admin/PIC (provincial) can create admin_wilayah for any of 6 DKI regions and is rejected (HTTP 400) when creating role=admin or role=super_admin; (3) admin_wilayah scoped to Jakarta Barat sees only Jakarta Barat participants — verified /api/admin/participants without region, with ?region=all, and with ?region=Jakarta Timur (JT peserta never leaks); (4) /api/admin/stats returns selected_region='Jakarta Barat' and available_regions=['Jakarta Barat'] even when queried with ?region=Jakarta Timur; (5) GET/PUT /api/admin/participants/{jt_user_id} return 404 for JB admin; (6) Own-region detail returns 200; (7) admin_wilayah is 403 on GET and POST /api/admin/users; (8) Export XLSX for admin_wilayah does not embed JT peserta email in payload; (9) Admin/PIC still sees all regions; (10) Super Admin can toggle+delete admin_wilayah; (11) Admin/PIC can delete admin_wilayah but not super_admin (404). Frontend (browser) verified: Admin/PIC login exposes menu-admin-wilayah + admin-users-manager + create-admin-btn opens dialog with admin-region-select and role-select restricted to ['admin_wilayah']; mobile 390px shows 0px horizontal overflow. Regional admin login (temp JB account) hides menu-admin-wilayah and menu-kampus, header shows 'Wilayah kerja: Jakarta Barat', and regional-admin-summary-scope indicator is rendered.
critical_code_review_comments: participant_scope_query fetches up to 5000 profiles then builds an $in array on user_id for every scoped request (list, stats, export, AI verification). For larger cohorts this becomes an O(N) round-trip on every request; consider persisting the resolved region directly on the registration document at submission time so scoping is a single query on `region`.

profile_region() reads `data.kota` OR `data.provinsi` — if a student enters kota='Bekasi' and provinsi='DKI Jakarta' they will never be scoped to any DKI region admin. Consider validating that kota is one of the 6 DKI regions when profile is saved for MDJ eligibility.

delete_user does not cascade — deleting an admin_wilayah keeps orphaned audit trail rows (history entries reference user.name only, which is fine, but any references by user_id in notifications/verifications are not purged). Not blocking for this feature.

AdminUsers.jsx line 43: canManageProvincial gate limits admin/PIC's role picker to only ['admin_wilayah'] which is correct, but the roleOptions comment says provincial admin gets 3 options — this is actually gated by prop passed from parent (super_admin only). Keep the JSX and the /api/admin/users backend allowed_roles in sync — currently consistent.
